codec.what_hint: Makes YouTube serve H.264 instead of VP9/AV1. Old or weak machines decode H.264 in hardware, so playback stops stuttering and the fan quiets down. Quality above 1080p may become unavailable.
codec.step1: Install the LibreGet browser extension and pair it in Settings.
codec.step2: Open the extension popup on any tab and turn on the H.264 toggle (third switch in the header).
codec.step3: Reload YouTube. The setting persists until you turn it off.
codec.extension_hint: The option lives in the extension because only it can run before YouTube's player loads.
codec.userscript_hint: Same trick as a userscript for Tampermonkey / Violentmonkey.

vcompress.two_pass: Two passes: the first measures, the second hits the target.

repair.gs_missing: Ghostscript not installed — the rebuild works alone, it just fixes less

exif.lossless: Stripping rewrites the container only — the image is not re-encoded.

iconpack.small_source: The source is {size}px — the larger icons were upscaled.
